title: zanthoxylum ocumarense
intro: Zanthoxylum ocumarense, commonly known as Peruvian pepper tree, is a plant species that belongs to the Rutaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents present in Zanthoxylum ocumarense, such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, are responsible for its therapeutic actions, which include pain relief, fever reduction, and wound healing. The plant's extracts have been shown to exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
